title: fact_for picks a line that does not answer for 10 committed eval rows, skips fact lines that name a backticked file, and still picks table header rows
goal: bench_pool.fact_for picks, for each committed eval and near-miss row, a line that answers its question (BP-4f71647e: ansible/dsc3-module.md:18, not :19; BP-d306eaa8: mecm/cmpivot.md:14, not the permission line :49; and BP-34d1ec62, BP-78d6bbfe, BP-c552cb0f, BP-df64045a, BP-9cdc47a9, BP-6b791ed3, BP-8f566d80, BP-70d0bf39); POINTER skips a line only when it does nothing but point to another file (mecm/cmpivot.md:14, claude/hooks.md:148, windows/windows-update-management.md:14 and intune/ios-android-management.md:13 state facts); a markdown table header row and lines inside a code block are never picked. A plain rebuild still moves no committed row; a later --redo then asks the model about the right line. Absorbed: BP-005970a5 (ASR rules with Warn mode, the LSASS rule's GUID in defender/asr-rules.csv:3) and BP-2413ce41 (the type of Graph beta isManagementRestricted, Edm.Boolean in graph/csdl-device.properties.csv:59) hold a hand-set single-regex check of the fact that answers them, which cached_checks keeps across rebuilds, not only an article path; pool check warns for each eval and near-miss row whose committed check matches no line fact_for picks now. Found by the SP-7y6dk257 review.

run: import subprocess,sys; o=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/benchmarks.py','pool','build','--redo','BP-4f71647e','--dry-run'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout; print(o); sys.exit(0 if 'dsc3-module.md:18' in o else 1)

import sys,re,json; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import bench_pool as bp; cases={'lookup_eval.csv:'+c['id']:c for c in bp.read_csv('kb/public/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv')}; rows=[(r,cases[r['source']]) for r in bp.read_csv('kb/public/_retrieval/bench_pool.csv') if r['source'] in cases and r['checks']]; bad=sorted({r['id'] for r,c in rows for f in [bp.fact_for('.',c)] if f and not any(re.search(x,f[2],re.I) for x in json.loads(r['checks']))}); print(len(bad),bad); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

import csv,json,re,sys; rows={r['id']:r for r in csv.DictReader(open('kb/public/_retrieval/bench_pool.csv',newline=''))}; bad=[i for i in ('BP-005970a5','BP-2413ce41') if any(re.search(chr(92)+'.(md|csv)$',c) for c in json.loads(rows[i]['checks']))]; print('path-only:',bad); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

gates.question: Four committed eval rows (BP-34d1ec62, BP-6b791ed3, BP-c552cb0f, BP-df64045a) keep a lexical fact_for pick that their model-written check does not match, and no further scoring signal moved them without breaking another committed row: extend each row's committed check by hand (one regex alternative that matches the picked line, as for the two absorbed rows), or leave the check and let pool check warn until a paid --redo rewrites it?
